subject: Quarterline: trajectory spotlight, decisions needed, and cross-team handoffs
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterline: trajectory spotlight, decisions needed, and cross-team handoffs

Team —

Quick mid‑quarter pulse ahead of the QBR packet cut next week. I want a short, actionable decision log so we can lock scope and run the deck by Finance on Monday. High‑level snapshot: 

- OKR A (Reduce inference cost / token): behind schedule — current rollout of caching/kv-prefetching delivering ~8% savings vs. 18% target. Still blocked on infra autoscaler tuning (see dependency A).
- OKR B (Latency SLO < 150ms p95): on track in hosted regions, but Dedicated tails showing regressions tied to grpc proxy change. Need a rollback plan or a mitigation.
- OKR C (Marketplace & Partner GTM): opportunity with Acme — potential $600k ARR; procurement and listing are gating final PO.

Decisions I need from this thread by EOD Monday (2026-07-26):
1) Defer the non‑critical quantization spike for OKR A and allocate infra cycles to autoscaler tuning (Owner: Markus) — yes/no?
2) Approve a temporary latency fallback policy for Dedicated (route to hosted by region) while we roll forward a patch (Owner: Kimberly) — yes/no?
3) Prioritize marketplace listing work for Acme (have partner CS jumping on it) and commit 0.5 PM for procurement (Owner: Vanessa) — confirm resource pull?

Attachments: QBR-readiness-deck-v2.pdf (draft slide pack), dependency-catalog.xlsx (current gating owners). Also linked: https://docs.redwood.com/qbr/soojin/spotlight.

Please reply with short bullets (Agree / Disagree / Need context) so I can compile to the decision log. If you want to propose alternate owners, note that here.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Product Ops | Redwood Inference
---

> 
> Quick mid‑quarter pulse ahead of the QBR packet cut next week...

Agree with the ask process — short bullets below: 

1) Defer quantization spike: Agree to deprioritize. Markus, we need an estimate of infra cycles (hrs) so we can reassign.
2) Temporary latency fallback: Need context. What is the expected customer impact of the fallback? If it increases host costs >10% we should gate with Finance sign‑off.
3) Marketplace listing priority: Agree in principle. Vanessa — can you put a short runbook for procurement handoff (steps + expected PoC timeline)?

I will follow up with infra to validate the autoscaler rollback window and cost delta.

Kim
Kimberly Park
VP, Site Reliability | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterline: trajectory spotlight, decisions needed, and cross-team handoffs

Soojin / all —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick replies: 

1) Defer quantization spike — I support. We can repurpose two infra engineers for autoscaler tuning for three sprints. Rough estimate: 120 engineering hours to complete tuning and validation, plus 40 hours for load testing. I'll update dependency-catalog.xlsx with the new ETA (target: 2026-08-16).

2) Fallback policy — Kimberly, happy to collaborate. Note that fallback will require a small change in request routing and an updated KV cache warmup to avoid tail latency spikes. We should be able to do a staged rollout if approved.

3) Marketplace — Vanessa, will need a technical signoff for listing artifacts (model card, perf profile). Markus can own the tech checklist with your PM.

Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference

- Acme procurement has requested our standard data processing addendum and an expected SOC2 attestation date. They're ready to sign contingent on marketplace listing + PO.
- I can commit a product marketing / PM half band (0.5 FTE) starting next Monday to drive listing assets and the procurement packet. Would prefer to finalize the listing window before the QBR if we can.

Attachment: marketplace-procurement-note.docx (procurement asks from Acme). Perry — do you have a tentative PO timeline?

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the transparency. Acme's procurement team has reviewed the marketplace note. Short answers: 
- We can target a PO signature the week of Aug 2 if listing is live and SOC2 attestation ETA is shared.
- We can do a joint demo + procurement review on Aug 4 or Aug 5 (we prefer Aug 4 morning PT).

Thanks, everyone — good thread. Finalizing decisions and action items below (please treat as committed unless you reply with a clear objection by 2026-07-26 EOD):

DECISIONS: 
- Quantization spike deferred; infra cycles reallocated to autoscaler tuning (Owner: Markus) — ETA: 2026-08-16.
- Approve temporary latency fallback policy for Dedicated, staged rollout; Finance to review if cost delta >10% (Owner: Kimberly + Markus).
- Marketplace listing prioritized for Acme; Vanessa to pull 0.5 PM and own procurement packet (Owner: Vanessa).

ACTION LOG: 
- Markus: Update dependency-catalog.xlsx with new ETAs and estimate (due 2026-07-24).
- Kimberly: Provide fallback cost estimate & rollback playbook (due 2026-07-25).
- Vanessa: Finalize procurement packet and confirm demo date with Acme (due 2026-07-27).
- Soojin: Cut decision log into the QBR deck and send to Finance for an early read (done by 2026-07-26).

Perry — noted on Aug 4 for joint demo. We'll avoid user‑impacting fallbacks during that window and will coordinate closely with your procurement lead.

I've updated the draft deck at: https://docs.redwood.com/qbr/soojin/spotlight (slide 5 = decision log). I'll merge Markus' ETA updates into the deck once I have the dependency-catalog update.

If no objections, I'll mark these as final and include them in the QBR packet.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Product Ops | Redwood Inference
